purpose: Teach: こむ/採っ/ひざ/向く/在る/挙句/物語っ/できあがっ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、急いで駆けこむお姿が印象的ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer rushing in earlier really made an impression, didn't it?
lines.style: Soft, observant tone. Noticing something meaningful without spelling it out. Gentle warmth in the voice—not probing, just reflecting back what she saw.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、コーヒー豆を産地まで行って採ったんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, I heard you went all the way to the source to collect those coffee beans yourself.
lines.style: Admiration underneath the surface. Slight smile in the voice. The tone of someone who noticed the care and is naming it quietly, without making a big thing of it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ひざを痛められたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, and I heard that customer hurt their knee...
lines.style: Softer now. Connecting the dots gently. Trailing off slightly—the implication is there, and she's letting Aoi find it herself.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様の心をお店に向くようにしたいね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, you want to make sure this customer feels like the shop is welcoming them back, right?
lines.style: Steady, practical underneath the gentleness. Not a question really—more a statement of what she already knows Aoi is thinking. Clear and grounded.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新メニューがいつも在る状態にしようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, let's keep that new menu available all the time, so they always have something to look forward to.
lines.style: Soft directive. Collaborative—'let's'—not commanding. The kindness in how she frames it: making sure the customer has continuity.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、議論の挙句、新コーヒーを採用したね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, and after all that discussion, you finally settled on a new coffee to feature.
lines.style: Quiet satisfaction. Reflecting back a process that took care. Not rushing—letting the weight of the decision sit for a moment.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご家族の思い出を物語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer even shared family memories with you over it.
lines.style: Wonder in the voice. The kind of quiet amazement at connection that doesn't need to be loud. A moment where something tender happened and she's honoring it by naming it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニューがやっとできあがって嬉しいね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, I'm so glad the new menu finally came together.
lines.style: Warmth and relief meeting in genuine happiness. Soft close—not effusive, but real. The satisfaction of something difficult becoming real.
